summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating: 1) green text contrast brightening, 2) mobile burger drawer obsidian black unification, 3) 2027 theme ('Mano pašaukimas' / 'My Purpose') & date modernization across email templates, and 4) GitGuardian security remediation: removing hardcoded passwords, replacing high-entropy test keys, ignoring runtime submission data in .gitignore, and sanitizing storage tokens.
